newsitem.title: ESTONIA: RAKVERE JUNE PROFIT 1.87 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: RAKVERE JUNE PROFIT 1.87 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Rakvere Meat Factory said on Friday it had a profit of 1.874 million kroons in June compared to 2.2 million kroons in May.
Its half-year loss was 2.8 million kroons, better than the estimated first-half loss of 5.2 million kroons, it added in a statement.
Its turnover was 55.7 million kroons in June. Compared to the same month last year, its turnover has grown by 23 percent and exports by 41 percent.
Its half-year turnover was 294.4 million kroons, up by 18 percent compared to the same period last year.
The company invested 14.7 million kroons during the first half, 40 percent of planned investments.
"Investments are continuously directed to increasing production effectiveness and capacity," it said.
Rigas Miesnieks, the Latvian meat producer whose majority shares it acquired in May, had a net turnover of six million lats or 146 million kroons in the first half.
Ekseko, the pig producer owned by Rakvere, had turnover of 36 million kroons in six months.
Rakvere Meat Factory results were given on an unconsolidated basis.
